svg.text: THROUGH THE BOOKCASE AT THE ARCH'S CROWN · 1:15
THROUGH THE CENTRE BAY AND PAINTING · 1:15
THROUGH THE WINDOW AT THE ARCH'S CROWN · 1:15
FLUSH WITH THE FRAME — NO GLASS
LINEN SHEER ON A SLIM TRACK
ON THE LINING, BEHIND THE VELVET
RED VELVET ON A TRACK LET INTO
THE SOFFIT — NO ROD · TIED BACK, BEYOND
REVEAL SILL ON TO THE COUNTER
All three cut looking along the wall to the right (cut lines on AST-DR-040's plan). Each arch's head is a ply former, veneered;
its three niches are boxes let into it, 90 deep, lined in the same veneer, a small focus light (3000 K) in the middle of each. The window's niches stay in the timber,
in front of the brick lintel. The window bay's panelling now runs at 280 like the rest, so the crown is one plane and the reveal 14 in.
Centre: panel at the wall plane, header at the cornice plane — the counter becomes a 9 in shelf under it. Details: AST-DR-043.

g.text: A–A bookcase · B–B centre · C–C window
2 — curtains inside the window arch, no rods; a focus light in each niche; a strip light under each shelf; the right reveal veneered (owner, 8 Oct)
